scope: Rust test declarations in Desktop source/integration plus CLI main/help/version and existing CLI remote device/control/invitation management. Macro-generated/runtime-discovered cases require reconciliation with CI discovery; declarations are not execution counts. Upstream additions are tracked separately.
rules: Keep original assertions and platform/cfg/ignore boundaries.
Resolve split-review entries individually before moving/removing originals.
Planned targets are ownership intent, not proof of implementation or execution.
Mixed-module ownership decisions are per test and reference ownershipRules; planned targets are not implementation or runtime evidence.
migrated-local-pass records only local aarch64-apple-darwin execution; other platforms, CI and final candidate acceptance remain separate.

ownershipRules.host-provider: Provider validation, atomic rollback and Agent RPC business; no Tauri types.
ownershipRules.host-fixture: Shared scripted RPC transport fixture and its own contract, independent of GUI.
ownershipRules.cli-entry: Headless argv, terminal display, login/pairing interaction, signals and entry error policy.
ownershipRules.gui-entry: GUI/IPC/plugin/installer or a named real product command integration; core service behavior is owned separately.
ownershipRules.host-approval: Approval lookup/rule persistence and Agent injection business shared by host entries.
ownershipRules.host-file: Canonical path/credential boundaries, inspection, file IO, attachment validation and persistence.
ownershipRules.host-review: Shared workspace/review selection, errors and data policy; no WebView needed.
ownershipRules.host-run-query: Agent journal and run/tool projection query business.
ownershipRules.host-task: Task normalization, revisions, schedule/enable rules and durable run ledger business.
ownershipRules.host-conversation: Conversation operations and Agent/Store coordination; terminal effects use entry hooks.
ownershipRules.host-skills: Shared skill RPC and recommendation budget business.
ownershipRules.host-workspace: Workspace service behavior; GUI IPC remains in its adapter.

baselineAuditSupplement.reason: Explicitly inventory the existing CLI device management/control tests before implementing the unified headless CLI entry. Original baseline source is read from its immutable Git object.
